nodes.title: Shared seed · clip N uses seed + N − 1
START HERE
widgets_values:
## START HERE

**Three Ref2VA clips · latent continuation · fixed soundtrack**

Load your song and two references per clip, then write each clip's prompt. Connect more IMAGE sockets on a clip for more references, or pipe one image loader into several clips.

**Durations are in frames** at fixed 24 fps. Clip 1: 5 + 17n (124 ≈ 5.17 s). Clips 2/3: NEW frames, multiples of 17 (119 ≈ 4.96 s each). Overlap is hidden and adds no output duration. Default total: 362 frames ≈ 15.08 s.

The song is trimmed to the planned duration, encoded once, and frozen while each clip samples video. Short songs fail with a clear error. The output muxes the original song by default; see Output controls.

One shared seed: clip N samples with seed + N − 1.

Models: [DaSiWa MiniMax H3 Hybrid v4 Turbo](https://civitai.com/models/2877206?modelVersionId=3392061) (INT8, 4 steps, res_multistep/sgm_uniform, shifts 7/4, CFG-free BasicGuider) in diffusion_models. Text encoder and VAEs: [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3). For other H3 checkpoints, adjust steps, sampler and shifts.

Attention defaults to Comfy Kitchen (INT8, Nvidia and AMD only); choose PyTorch attention elsewhere.

Requires ComfyUI-Minimax-H3-Continuation 0.6.3 or newer, installed from Git.

nodes.title: Output controls
widgets_values:
## Output controls

The final cumulative AV latent contains all three clips with duplicated context removed. Decode video once. Use original soundtrack defaults ON: mux the continuous trimmed source after video decoding, bypassing audio VAE loss and audio transition seams. OFF uses decoded fixed audio.

The same source offset and planned range feed conditioning and final audio. No per-clip audio joins or fades are needed. Save Video still applies the chosen container's audio codec; this is waveform replacement, not compressed-stream copying.

Keep playback at 24 fps. Change tiled VAE controls here if needed. Final video lands under output/video/FixedSoundtrack/.

To inspect an earlier clip, reconnect Separate AV Latent to clip 1's sampler or clip 2's append.

Each audio report lists exact fresh/carried token counts. The source offset is shared; per-clip durations drive the continuous audio timeline automatically.

nodes.title: Clip 1 · Ref2VA initial
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the cat-eared girl shown in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. <Picture 1> is a close-up of her face; <Picture 2> shows her full outfit in a crouching, cat-like pose. She has long black hair with purple streaks in twin tails, black cat ears with purple insides, skull hair clips with purple ribbons, orange eyes, a black collar with a silver bell, a black lace-trimmed dress and black boots.

summary:
A continuous, energetic pop-dance music video about a cat, segment 1 of three.

retention_analysis:
Preserve <Subject 1>'s face, hair, accessories and outfit from both references, and the plain grey concrete studio with its diagonal shadow from <Picture 2>.

detailed_description:
<Subject 1> starts low in the crouching cat pose from <Picture 2> and swipes one hand like a paw. She rises onto her feet on the beat and starts to dance, singing with lip movements synchronized to the soundtrack. The camera slowly pushes in.
